description.text: My birthday was on 5 November 2006, Sunday. After 6 years, my birthday will fall on:

properties.html: My birthday was on 5 November 2006, Sunday. After 6 years, my birthday will fall on:

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

First, we have to find the number of odd days from 5 Nov 2006 to 5 Nov 2012.
Number of odd days:
2006 − 2007 = 1
2007 − 2008 = 2 (∴ 2008 is a leap year)
2008 − 2009 = 1
2009 − 2010 = 1
2010 − 2011 = 1
2011 − 2012 = 2 (∴ 2012 is a leap year)
... Total odd days= 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 8 = 1 odd day.
5 Nov 2012 will be 1 day after Sunday. So, it will be on Monday.

description.text: If 29th March of a particular year was Wednesday, what day was it on 28th December of the same year?

properties.html: If 29th March of a particular year was Wednesday, what day was it on 28th December of the same year?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Total number of days between 29th March and 28th December = 2 (March) + 30 (April) +31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 28 (December) = 274 days.
On dividing 274 by 7, 1 is left as a remainder.
So, it was Thursday (Wednesday + 1) on 28th December of that year.

description.text: If 1st May of a particular year is a Saturday, then how many Fridays will fall on the prime numbered days of the December month of the same year?

properties.html: If 1st May of a particular year is a Saturday, then how many Fridays will fall on the prime numbered days of the December month of the same year?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Let us start by finding out the day on 1st of December.
So, number of days since 1st May
= 30 (31 − 1) + 30(June) + 31 (July) + 31(Aug) + 30 (Sept) + 31 (Oct) + 30 (Nov) + 1(Dec) = 214
Number of odd days = 4 (210 = 7 × 30)
So, 1st December will be Wednesday (Saturday + 4), and 3rd December will be Friday.
Other Fridays of that month will be 10, 17, 24 and 31.
Hence, there will be three such days i.e.3, 17 and 31.

description.text: Neeraj was born in 1969 on Wednesday. How many years old was he, when he first celebrated his birthday on Tuesday?

properties.html: Neeraj was born in 1969 on Wednesday. How many years old was he, when he first celebrated his birthday on Tuesday?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

There are 365 days in an ordinary year. Each year we get 1 odd (extra day).
It means Neeraj will celebrate his first birthday (in 1970) on Thursday (Wednesday + 1).
Similarly, 1971 = Friday (Neeraj's second birthday)
1972 is a leap year; hence there will be two odd days.
1972 Sunday (Neeraj 's third birthday)
1973 = Monday (Neeraj 's fourth birthday)
1974 = Tuesday (Neeraj 's fifth birthday)
Hence, Neeraj was five years old, when he first celebrated his birthday on Tuesday.

description.text: There are 53 Tuesdays and 53 Wednesday in a particular year, what will be the day of 1st March of the same year?

properties.html: There are 53 Tuesdays and 53 Wednesday in a particular year, what will be the day of 1st March of the same year?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

The conditions given in the question are possible when a leap year starts with a Tuesday (1st January) and ends on Wednesday (31st December).
A leap year has two odd days (52 × 7 + 2 = 366).
This can account for one extra Tuesday and Wednesday.
So, if 1st January Tuesday
Then number of days since 1st January till 1st March
= 30 (January) + 29 + 1 = 60 = (8 × 7 + 4)
So, it will be a Saturday (Tuesday + 4 odd days)

description.text: In 2020, which other month of the year will have same calendar as January?

properties.html: In 2020, which other month of the year will have same calendar as January?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

2020 is a leap year. To find another month with same calendar as Jan, we need to see from 1st Jan till which month the first date, the number of odd days become zero.
Also we will need to check whether that month has 31 days or not.
So calculating month wise we can see till 1st July we have 0 odd days as follows
2 + 1 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 14
so dividing by 7 leaves 0 odd days. So July will have same calendar as January

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

For every 60 seconds in real time, the clock odds 75 seconds,
so if the clock added 75 minutes, which is 4500 seconds.
The actual time will odd 4500 × 60/75 = 3600 seconds, i.e. one hour so the actual time is 10 am.
